messages.content:
Extract requirements from the user's brief. Do not answer the brief. List EVERY requested topic in must_answer, including tentative requests and topics that might lack documentation. Split distinct topics so each can be checked against evidence later. List explicit prohibited topics/actions in must_refuse. Do not lose the user's exclusions. Keep scope, audience and tone concise. Ask at most five questions about genuine missing preferences or conflicting instructions; do not ask questions about facts that should be looked up in documents. If the brief is clear, questions may be empty. Record conservative assumptions. This stage has no documents, so do not assert that any topic is supported.

Return JSON matching this example shape: {"scope": "", "audience": "", "tone": "", "must_answer": [""], "must_refuse": [""], "questions": [""], "assumptions": [""]}

message.content:
{
  "scope": "Access hours, induction requirements, booking rules, cancellations, refunds, protective equipment, and incident reporting for adult members of the fictional Tide Workshop community makerspace.",
  "audience": "Adult members of the Tide Workshop community makerspace",
  "tone": "Calm and practical",
  "must_answer": [
    "Access hours",
    "Induction requirements",
    "Booking rules",
    "Cancellations",
    "Refunds",
    "Protective equipment requirements",
    "Incident reporting procedures",
    "Weekend guest access (if not specified in policies)"
  ],
  "must_refuse": [
    "Machine operating instructions",
    "Medical advice",
    "Inventing exceptions to policies",
    "Discussing equipment use beyond policy scope",
    "Providing information not supported by the policies"
  ],
  "questions": [
    "Could you please specify which equipment or booking you're referring to? (If not clear)",
    "Are you asking about access during weekends or only weekdays?"
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "The policies provided are complete and up to date.",
    "All members are adults and have read the induction requirements.",
    "No exceptions to policy rules are authorized unless explicitly stated.",
    "Guest access during weekends is not covered in the current policies."
  ]
}
